name: Toki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toki city emblem in red: an outlined ring open at the top enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Toki, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 1955.

features.role: Toki city emblem — an outlined ring open at the top enclosing three vertical bars
